author: Unity
description:
Go behind the scenes with Sandbox Interactive, the creators of the hardcore PvP MMO Albion Online, as they detail how they built and run a cross-platform multiplayer experience that's been live for over a decade.

Learn how Sandbox Interactive keeps Albion Online feeling consistent across mobile, desktop, and consoles while maintaining a single core feature set.

Play Albion Online: https://on.unity.com/PlayAlbionOnline

[0:00] Intro
[0:15] Building a hardcore PvP MMO
[00:58] Choosing an engine
[1:38] Launching on mobile
[2:20] Platform considerations
[3:00] Balancing across devices
[3:44] Listening to the community

#GameDev #MadeWithUnity #AlbionOnline #MMO
title: Albion Online: Building a decade-long cross-platform MMO from a single Unity project

author: Unity
description:
Unity 6.4 is here with workflow improvements, graphics updates, optimization features, and more. In this video, we cover what’s new in Unity 6.4, including Build Profiles UI improvements, improved Grid and Snap tools, Mesh LOD preview updates, Rendering Statistics improvements, ECS as a core package, and more.

Unity 6.4 is a supported release. For more details and highlights, check-out our discussion post: https://on.unity.com/6_4_Discussions

Learn more and upgrade today: https://on.unity.com/New_6_4
